in_marathi.name: Parkesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Vishnu's Abode
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parkesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Parkesh is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a compound word consisting of 'Para' meaning supreme and 'Kshetra' meaning place or abode. Parkesh, as a name, is believed to bring blessings of peace, prosperity, and protection.
